svg.text: Production Serving with GitHub Actions Automated Verification

div.style: color: #C0CAF5; font-family: monospace; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.65; white-space: pre-wrap;

foreignObject.div:
# Dockerfile for High-Throughput Inference Service FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app COPY requirements.txt . RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY src/ /app/src/ COPY models/random_forest_clf.pkl /app/models/
ENV MODEL_PATH=/app/models/random_forest_clf.pkl EXPOSE 8000
# Multi-worker Uvicorn ASGI server with Gunicorn process manager CMD ["uvicorn", "src.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000", "--workers", "4"]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # GitHub Actions .github/workflows/ci-cd.yaml name: Model Pipeline CI/CD on: [push, pull_request] jobs: test-and-validate: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v3 - name: Set up Python uses: actions/setup-python@v4 with: { python-version: '3.11' } - name: Run Pytest Test Suite run: pytest tests/ --maxfail=1 --cov=src - name: Model Validation (ROC-AUC > 0.90) run: python tests/verify_threshold.py --min-auc 0.90
